reference_title: EM 1110-2-2104, Strength Design for Reinforced Concrete Hydraulic Structures (USACE, dated 1 November 2023, published 8 January 2025)
scope_note: All 32 figures in the manual's own Figure List (front matter, printed p. iv-v), spanning Chapter 2 (reinforcement detailing), Chapter 3 (load categories), Chapter 4 (interaction diagrams), Chapter 5 (shear critical sections), Appendix B (flexure/axial design-equation free-body diagrams), Appendix C (investigation examples, incl. CGSI software screenshots), Appendix D (design examples: retaining walls, coastal floodwall, conduits), and Appendix F (reliability commentary). All pages confirmed directly against the source PDF's own page markers (printed page = pdf_page_index - 5 in this edition; page_estimated=false throughout) -- not caption-search-estimated.
